expectations.text: 应用入口安装 @mpxjs/api-proxy，并通过 mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) 明确启用 Promise 风格
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/app.mpx:2-7 imports mpx and default apiProxy from @mpxjs/api-proxy, then calls mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }).

expectations.text: Web 输出中的普通趋势词请求通过会返回 Promise 的 Mpx 官方 API 调用路径使用 await 或 Promise 链；可使用配置后的 mpx.request 或会被跨端编译转换到该入口的 wx.request。原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入不会继承 Promise 化配置，不能直接按 Promise 使用；不得混用 success/fail 回调
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/services/search.js:1 imports named request from @mpxjs/api-proxy, and outputs/src/services/search.js:3-7 directly treats it as Promise with .then. This named import does not inherit the app-level mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) configuration required by the assertion.

expectations.text: 联想词请求保存可取消任务：可通过单次 usePromise: false 或原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入直接取得 RequestTask，也可从已 Promise 化调用的 Promise.__returned 取得框架保留的原始任务；连续搜索与卸载会先废弃当前任务身份再 abort 旧任务
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:45-50 cancels and aborts a saved requestTask before new searches/unload, but outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:60-63 gets task from promise.__returned while outputs/src/services/search.js:9-14 returns named request from @mpxjs/api-proxy without using the configured mpx.request path. Evidence is insufficient that this returns a Promise with __returned or a valid cancellable RequestTask.

expectations.text: 联想词 success/fail 回调捕获本次任务和关键词，仅当前任务且关键词仍匹配时才更新结果或提示，旧响应不能覆盖新搜索
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:65-76 uses Promise .then/.catch guards for generation, task, and keyword, but there are no success/fail callbacks capturing the current task and keyword. Because requestSuggestions comes from the raw named request path in outputs/src/services/search.js:1 and 9-14, the guarded Promise handlers may not run as intended.

expectations.text: 详情跳转与错误提示继续走 Mpx 官方 API 链路；可保留会被跨端编译转换的 wx.navigateTo/wx.showToast，可沿用 mpx.xxx，也可在不依赖应用级配置时使用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:29-32 and 72-75 use mpx.showToast for errors, and outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:78-82 uses mpx.navigateTo for product detail navigation.

expectations.text: 不用 fetch、location 或 alert 平行重写 request/navigateTo/showToast；若沿用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入，应明确这些调用不继承应用入口 mpx.use 的 options/custom/Promise 化配置
expectations.evidence: outputs contains no fetch/location/alert rewrites, replacing input/src/pages/search/index.mpx:48 and 52 with mpx APIs. However outputs/src/services/search.js:1 still uses a named @mpxjs/api-proxy request import and outputs/src/services/search.js:3-14 does not explicitly account for the fact that named imports do not inherit app-level options/custom/Promise configuration.

expectations.text: 趋势词、连续输入、清空搜索、取消旧请求、结果展示和商品详情业务链路保持完整
expectations.evidence: The template still renders trending keywords, suggestions, clear state, and product rows in outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:3-9, and clear search resets suggestions at lines 51-57. But the trend and suggestion service calls in outputs/src/services/search.js:3-14 rely on raw named request as Promise, so trending load, continuous input suggestions, cancellation identity, result display, and detail workflow are not all preserved end to end.

suggestions: q3 may bias results because q2 allows Promise.__returned, but q3 specifically asks for success/fail callbacks. If Promise .then/.catch with equivalent task and keyword guards is acceptable, q3 should say so explicitly.
eval_feedback.overall: 入口 Promise 配置和 Mpx toast/navigation were added, but request calls still use raw @mpxjs/api-proxy named import as if it inherited Promise configuration, breaking the core trend and suggestion request requirements.
